
A string begins with a '''fu'ivla''' if it does not begin with a [[jbocre: Morphology: c|cmavo]] or a '''rafsi-string''' or a '''slinku'i''', it does begin with a non-[[jbocre: Morphology: consonants]] [[jbocre: Morphology: syllables nset]], and consists of any number of [[jbocre: Morphology: syllables nstressed-syllable]]s (possibly none), one [[jbocre: Morphology: syllables tressed-syllable]] and then a [[jbocre: Morphology: syllables inal-syllable]].

A '''rafsi-string''' consists of any number of [[jbocre: Morphology: rafsi -less-rafsi]] (possibly none) followed by a [[jbocre: Morphology: g|gismu]], a [[jbocre: Morphology: rafsi VV-final-rafsi]], or a [[jbocre: Morphology: rafsi tressed-y-less-rafsi]] and a [[jbocre: Morphology: rafsi hort-final-rafsi]]

A '''slinku'i''' consists of a [[jbocre: Morphology: consonants onsonant]] followed by a '''rafsi-string'''.
